title: Freestanding paper towel holder 14.4-Inch solid brass countertop stand, Carolina Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your countertop with a freestanding paper towel holder that keeps a roll upright and ready while saving space. This Carolina Collection stand is crafted from solid brass and uses a weighted base to help stay stable when tearing sheets. A felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches.

Highlights:
- Freestanding paper towel holder (countertop paper towel stand) requires no wall mounting
- Solid brass construction for a refined, traditional look
- Space-saving upright design keeps the roll accessible
- Designer finish supports corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina and coordinated classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H; projection 6.5-Inch
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement finishes such as Venetian Bronze, Spanish Gold, Lavender, Pink, and Mediterranean Blue

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
